name: web-floating-icon-toolbar-with-black-tooltip-and-notification-dots
title: White pill toolbar of six line icons with two notification dots and a black 'Feature Flags' tooltip above the hovered icon
whatItIs: A white page with a floating rounded pill with a soft shadow holding six black line icons (chat, inbox with a dot, toggle highlighted in a grey circle, pencil, share, menu with a dot) and a black rounded tooltip 'Feature Flags' above the hovered icon.
whatItMeans: Light and helpful; a tooltip names a bare icon exactly when needed.
techniques: Float a pill toolbar with a soft shadow.
Show a black tooltip above it.

vocabulary.definition: A rounded container of icon buttons.
A small label shown on hover.
A small filled dot on an icon.
A tint behind the icon under the cursor.
